# vendor/summary — our restatements of sources we may not copy

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT -->

Each file here is written by this project, in its own words, and is MIT like
the rest of the repository. Each names the upstream, its copyright holder and
licence, the revision read, and then restates only the facts this project
relies on, with page or line references so a reader with the original can
check them. Nothing is quoted beyond a short phrase needed for precision.

The clean-room specifications in `specs/` are the canonical behaviour
statements; a summary here is the attribution record plus the raw facts
(datasheet numbers, licence terms, software facts) behind them.
